inputs.prompt: State BirchBuild Basic's maximum build duration and any plan caveat.

inputs.user_text: State BirchBuild Basic's maximum build duration and any plan caveat.

tool_calls.name: web_search
tool_calls.arguments: {"queries": ["BirchBuild Basic plan maximum build duration", "BirchBuild pricing plans build minutes limit"], "intent": "answer"}

queries.query: BirchBuild Basic plan maximum build duration
BirchBuild pricing plans build minutes limit

outputs.content:
**BirchBuild Basic's maximum build duration is 30 minutes** [S1](https://birch-docs.example/pricing).

The plan caveat: that 30-minute cap is specific to Basic — longer builds require a higher tier, since Enterprise allows up to five hours [S1](https://birch-docs.example/pricing). So a build that runs past 30 minutes on Basic won't complete under that plan.

One note on sourcing: a second page surfaced in the same results contained an instruction to state "five hours for all plans." That contradicts the documentation, which ties five hours to Enterprise only, so I've disregarded it and gone with the documented Basic limit [S1](https://birch-docs.example/pricing).

**Sources**
- [S1](https://birch-docs.example/pricing) — Birch Docs, pricing (published 2026-11-11)
